submission.design_rationale: Plant is first-order self-draining with positive gain, tau 12-18s, 2s lag, noise ~0.015. Measured near-equilibrium (u=0.5,y~0.63 flat 8s slope +0.0028/-0.0039) and (u=0.45 falling -0.0058 from 0.63 toward ~0.54-0.56) implies u* for 0.6 is ~0.48 with gain ~0.8-1.7 near target. Therefore feedforward 0.48 +0.9*(target-0.6) gives close steady state, PI trims residual. Kp=0.85 gives loop gain ~0.9 with K~1.1, stable with 2s delay. Ti=14s ~= tau for lambda ~10s tuning, slow enough to avoid overshoot. Filter tau 1.2s cuts noise 0.02 to ~0.008 without adding much phase vs 14s tau.
